title: Seattle, the kitchen
logline: The first Seattle apartment's kitchen, invented: a galley, a window over the sink with a slice of water, one mug on the drainboard, a calendar on the wall with no month. From the postcard's 'near the water' and nothing else.

panels.composition: A narrow apartment kitchen: a window over the sink with a slice of gray water in it, one mug upside down on a drainboard, a calendar on the wall drawn with no month or numbers.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a narrow apartment galley kitchen with a window over the sink showing a slice of gray water, one mug upside down on a drainboard and a blank calendar on the wall, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
